title: Structural Life‑Regime Profiles
description: Structural Life‑Regime Profiles introduce a unified, triadic substrate for mapping biological organisms, autonomous systems, robotics stacks, synthetic lifeforms, and non‑biological coherence systems into a shared structural grammar. The artifact defines regime axes, taxonomy, drift and stability profiles, and cross‑domain examples including humans, chimpanzees, Chrysina gloriosa, LLM agents, robotics stacks, synthetic lifeforms, and crystalline entities. It extends the TriadicFrameworks canon by providing a vST‑aligned framework for life‑regime comparison and autonomous system alignment.
